Paste the complete HTML the AI gave you into the editor. The preview updates as you paste.

Pick a ready-made school website. It loads into the editor and the preview.

Save your website as a file.
  1. Select Copy Code above the editor.
  2. Open the Web Development folder, right-click SchoolWebsite.html, then select Edit in Notepad.
  3. Press Ctrl + V, then Ctrl + S.
  4. Close Notepad, then double-click SchoolWebsite.html again.
  5. You should see your school website.
